To do this, you need to register in our powerful network through an invitation from an existing ÖRDO rider. If you don't have an invitation from an ÖRDO rider, please let us know, and we will assign you a sponsor rider to whom you can register through their invitation. This sponsor rider will also guide you on how to grow your ÖRDO network significantly.
